title: Local coherence for representations of amalgams
summary: In all forms of the local Langlands program the abelian category of smooth representations of p-adic groups G in vector spaces over a field k plays a central role. Of particular interest are its finiteness properties. If the field k has characteristic zero then, by work of Bernstein, this category is most of the time locally noetherian. But if the field has characteristic p then this remains the case only for very special groups.
